beverages.name: Strawberry Milkshake
beverages.instructions: Blend strawberries with milk, sugar, and ice cream until smooth.

beverages.name: Banana Milkshake
beverages.instructions: Blend banana with milk, honey, and ice cream until smooth.

beverages.name: Hot Chocolate
beverages.instructions: Heat milk with cocoa powder and sugar, top with whipped cream.

beverages.name: Chocolate Milk
beverages.instructions: Mix milk with chocolate syrup and serve chilled.

beverages.name: Milk Tea
beverages.instructions: Brew tea, mix with milk and sugar. Add boba if desired.

beverages.name: Coffee
beverages.instructions: Brew coffee and mix with milk and sugar.

beverages.name: Lemonade
beverages.instructions: Mix lemon juice with water, sugar, and ice cubes.

food.name: Scrambled Eggs
food.instructions: Beat eggs with milk and salt, cook in butter until soft.

food.name: Mashed Potatoes
food.instructions: Boil potatoes, mash with butter, milk, salt, and pepper.

food.name: Blueberry Pancakes
food.instructions: Mix ingredients, cook batter on pan, add berries as topping.

food.name: Strawberry Pancakes
food.instructions: Mix ingredients, cook batter on pan, add berries as topping.

food.name: French Toast
food.instructions: Dip bread in egg mixture and fry until golden brown.

food.name: Salad
food.instructions: Chop vegetables, mix with olive oil and salt.

food.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
food.instructions: Butter bread, add cheese, grill until golden and melted.

food.name: Spaghetti
food.instructions: Cook spaghetti, mix with sauce, drizzle olive oil and sprinkle cheese.

food.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
food.instructions: Stir-fry kimchi and vegetables, add rice and seasonings, top with fried egg.

food.name: Tteokbokki
food.instructions: Cook rice cakes and fish cakes in sauce until tender.

food.name: Fruit Salad
food.instructions: Chop all fruits and drizzle with honey.

chefKooSpecial.name: Uni Cream Shrimp Pasta
chefKooSpecial.instructions: Infuse oil with green onion and shrimp heads. Boil pasta. Stir-fry garlic and seasonings, add uni soy sauce, heavy cream, butter, sugar, chopped shrimp. Simmer, add pasta, toss, finish with cheese and green onion.

chefKooSpecial.name: Bulguri Ramen
chefKooSpecial.instructions: Add 650-680ml water to pan, add sauce and garnish, boil, add noodles, thicken broth, top with garnish.

chefKooSpecial.name: BulMayo Perilla Oil Makguksu
chefKooSpecial.instructions: Boil noodles, rinse in cold water, mix sauces and egg yolk, pour over noodles, top with seaweed.

chefKooSpecial.name: Scrambled Egg Toast with Jam
chefKooSpecial.instructions: Beat eggs with milk, cook scrambled eggs, toast bread, spread butter and jam, top with eggs.
